plans.label: Version 1: AGREE

plans.point1: The reliance on digital platforms for communication has reduced the quality of human connection, as face-to-face interactions are replaced by text messages that lack tone and nuance, making genuine emotional understanding less common.

plans.point1: Digital platforms provide unprecedented opportunities for emotional connection, enhancing human rapport.

plan.focus: 探讨数字时代人类同理心的下降趋势及其影响
